header: Prose on one side, a picture on the other
bodytext:
The two-column workhorse. A toggle swaps the sides so consecutive bands can alternate down a page, and the text column stops at sixty characters however wide the band is set — half of a full-bleed band is still far too wide for a paragraph.

Below 768px there is only one column, and the picture is placed first: on a phone the thing being explained should arrive before the explanation of it.
caption: The picture keeps its own proportions at every width.
